articles.title: Isro invites academia to partner on future missions with RESPOND-2025
articles.summary: ISRO has initiated the RESPOND-2025 program, inviting academic institutions across India to partner on upcoming space missions. This strategic move aims to foster collaboration between the national space agency and the academic community, leveraging their expertise for advancements in space research and technology development. The initiative seeks to integrate academic innovation directly into ISRO's future projects, strengthening India's capabilities in space exploration through joint efforts and shared knowledge.

articles.title: Naval diving support craft DSC A20 commissioned at Kochi to boost underwater capabilities
articles.summary: The Indian Navy commissioned its new naval diving support craft, A20, in Kochi, significantly enhancing its underwater capabilities. This vessel is purpose-built to boost underwater preparedness and serve as a crucial force multiplier for various sub-surface operations. Its induction strengthens the Navy's operational readiness and strategic maritime presence, underscoring India's commitment to robust defence infrastructure.
